topic: Senescent cells: 'zombie cells' and their removal
caption: Did you know your body has 'zombie cells' that refuse to die? 🧠💀 These senescent cells can cause aging and disease. 🌟 Here are 5 key facts: senescent cells accumulate with age, they can drive inflammation, clearing them can improve health, senolytic therapy is a promising approach, and research is ongoing to understand their role. 💡 Save this so you don't lose it. Share with someone who needs to see this. Follow @healthrecode for daily science-backed health. Don't forget — your future body will thank you. #senescentcells #cellularaging #healthyliving
